resources.string: Clearing codes and rereading the ECU…
No codes have been read yet. Turn the ignition on, connect the adapter, then tap “Read codes”.
Clear codes (mode 04) for: %1$s. The ECU will be read again to check whether they return.
I confirm the vehicle is stopped
Likely causes, most to least common
General guidance, not the manufacturer\'s procedure. The title is the generic SAE J2012 description.
AI explanation is unavailable right now.
Reading saved in session “%1$s”, with the freeze frame and guide checklist.
Session “%1$s” is open: guide checkboxes are saved there.
No diagnostic session is open. This reading and its checklist won\'t be saved.
Save this reading in a new session
Engine state when the ECU stored the fault.
Saved in the session: it stays there even if you clear the codes.
It will be lost when you clear the codes unless you save it in a session.
RevScope doesn\'t recognize this code format.
The ECU didn\'t respond to the active-code request (03), so this doesn\'t confirm that there are no faults. Read the codes again.
The ECU didn\'t respond to these code requests: %1$s. Some ECUs don\'t support these requests; active codes were read.
The connection was lost at the end of the read; the freeze frame may be incomplete.
Couldn\'t save the step: the session is no longer open
There\'s no recent speed reading to confirm that the vehicle is stopped.
The vehicle is moving at %1$s km/h. Stop before clearing the codes.
Readiness monitors will be incomplete: the vehicle may fail a safety inspection until drive cycles are completed.
Clearing codes doesn\'t repair anything. If the fault remains, the code will return.
The freeze frame (engine state when the fault was stored) will be cleared from the ECU; it\'s saved in the session.
The freeze frame (engine state when the fault was stored) will be lost. Save the reading in a session first.
The ECU rejected the clear (7F 04 22: conditions not correct). Many ECUs only clear codes with the engine off: turn off the engine, leave the ignition on, and try again. The codes are still stored.
Couldn\'t send the clear request: the adapter didn\'t respond. Read the codes again before trying.
The clear request was sent, but the ECU still reports %1$s: the fault is still present.
The clear request was sent, but the ECU couldn\'t be reread to confirm it. Read the codes again.
